bls_comparator.construction_note: This BLS nonfarm-business all-worker measure differs from EPI's total-economy net-productivity and typical-worker compensation construction, so numerical agreement is not expected.

claim_boundary: The result can describe source-specific wage/productivity divergence. It cannot identify fiat-money causality, transfer mechanisms, distributional welfare, or a policy prescription.

distribution_lane.blocker: The frozen primary panel does not contain source-locked median, quantile, household-disposable-income, or industry-composition series; aggregate wage/productivity results cannot be presented as distributional evidence.

epi_replication.comparison_to_book: Report any difference as a source-vintage or construction difference; do not select the closer result.
